messages:
Priya: FYI — final-round candidate (Search infra) at 3pm. Building maintenance kicked out Conf B. Need either Conf A (onsite) or a virtual scribe who can own debrief. Anyone available to jump?
Samir: I can take Conf A and run the onsite portion.
Maya K: I'm free to scribe virtually if Samir covers onsite. What's the rubric split for this role? design vs system?
Priya: Thanks Samir. Maya — rubric is 60% systems, 30% design/architecture, 10% culture. See debrief anchors: https://redwood.internal/debriefs/search-infra-final (pls don't share externally).
Elena: Happy to scribe if Maya is heads-down on interviewing. I can grab recording + notes.
Priya: Elena that works — can you also confirm recording consent at start? Script: "Hi — quick note, we'll record for debrief and retention, opt-out is fine."
calendar-bot: Meeting moved: 3pm Search Infra final — now in Conf A (onsite) + Zoom link; attendees updated.
people-ops-bot: Debrief template added to the event. Link: https://redwood.internal/templates/debrief-lite.md
Samir: Quick ops: who's owning score normalization? We should convert 1-5 into z-scores before avg?
Priya: I'll normalize. Use per-interviewer mean/std dev across the panel; cap at +/-2. If someone has extreme outlier call me.
Maya K: One last ask — can we lock the rubric weights in the event description so scribe has them? I'll paste quick block:
```
Systems: 60
Design: 30
Culture: 10
```
Priya: done — pasted into event. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Elena: Recording started. Candidate consent: confirmed.
Samir: Onsite running. Will ping if we need last-minute swaps.
Priya: Appreciate the cover team. Post-debrief I'll raise any calibration if needed. :rocket:
